        // OCNOW-11988 (Cursor): Proactively focus skip link when returning from browser chrome.

        (function () {

            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();

							                  <!--normalTemplateStart--><h1 class='oc-page-title '>Council Meetings</h1>


<p>Snowy Valleys Council is made up of <a href="https://www.snowyvalleys.nsw.gov.au/Council/About-SVC/Your-Councillors" target="_blank">nine publicly elected Councillors</a>.  </p>
<p>Council meets at least once a month. Members of the public are welcome to attend Council meetings as observers.  Meetings are recorded and also streamed live on our youtube channel <a href="https://www.youtube.com/c/snowyvalleyscouncil" target="_blank">www.youtube.com/c/snowyvalleyscouncil</a></p>
<p><strong>Public Forum</strong></p>
<p>Individuals wishing to address Council can do so at the Public Forum held immediately prior to the meeting. An application must be made in writing 48 hours before the meeting. Refer to the Public Forum Guidelines and application form for more details.</p>
<ul>
<li><a title="Public-Forum-Guidelines-SVC-EXE-Gdl-048-01.pdf" href="/files/assets/public/v/1/meeting-minutes-amp-agendas/council-meetings/council-meeting-forms-and-guidelines/public-forum-guidelines-svc-exe-gdl-048-01.pdf" target="_self" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>SVC-Public-Forum-Guidelines<span class="file-info">(PDF, 240KB)</span></a></li>
<li><a title="Public-Forum-Application-Form-SVC-EXE-F-276-01.pdf" href="/files/assets/public/v/1/meeting-minutes-amp-agendas/council-meetings/council-meeting-forms-and-guidelines/public-forum-application-form-svc-exe-f-276-01.pdf" target="_self" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>SVC-Public-Forum-Application-Form<span class="file-info">(PDF, 223KB)</span></a></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Code of Meeting Practice</strong></p>
<p>All Council Meetings are governed by a code of meeting practices. The SVC Code of Meeting Practice provides details of the procedures and standards for the conduct of Council business at meetings.  <a title="Code-of-Meeting-Practice-2025-SVC-EXE-M-023-06" href="/files/assets/public/v/8/meeting-minutes-amp-agendas/council-meetings/council-meeting-forms-and-guidelines/code-of-meeting-practice-2026-svc-exe-m-023-08.pdf" target="_blank" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Snowy Valleys Council Code of Meeting Practice<span class="file-info">(PDF, 448KB)</span></a></p>
<p>Agendas for monthly ordinary Council meetings, along with any extraordinary Council meetings, are available to the public prior to each meeting.</p>

</ul>

<script id="COVID_TEMP-script">
	$(document.getElementById('COVID_TEMP-messages').innerHTML).find('.item').each(function(){
		var $message = $(this);
		var isMatch = false;
		$message.find('.conditions a').each(function(){
			var $a = $(this);
			var mode = $a.text().split(' ')[0].toLowerCase();
			var value = $a.attr('href').replace(/^https?:\/\//g, '');

			switch(mode)
			{
				case 'startswith':
					if(document.location.pathname.toLowerCase().startsWith(value.toLowerCase()))
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;

				case 'contains':
					if(document.location.pathname.toLowerCase().indexOf(value.toLowerCase()) !== -1)
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;

				case 'regex':
					var re = new RegExp(value);
					if(new RegExp(value).test(document.location.pathname))
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;

				default:
					if(document.location.pathname.toLowerCase() === value.toLowerCase())
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;
			}
		});
		if(isMatch)
		{
			var $main = $('#main-content');
			if($main.length === 0) return false;
			var $h1 = $main.find('h1').first();

			var title = $message.find('.title').text().trim();
			var type = $message.find('.type').text().trim();
			var description = $message.find('.description').html();
			var link = $message.find('.link').html();

			var $content = $('<section>').addClass('obj-venue');//class is a hack to inherit styling
			var $sideBox = $('<div>').addClass('side-box message-box message-type-'+type).appendTo($content);

			if(title !== '')
			{
				$('<h2>').addClass('side-box-title').text(title).appendTo($sideBox);
			}

			var descriptionBox = ''

			if(description.trim() !== '')
			{
				//If the description contains no html tags, wrap the text in p tags
				var noBrDesc = description.split('<br>').join('\r\n');
				if (!/<[^>]+>/.test(noBrDesc)) {
					description = '<p>' + noBrDesc.replace(/(\r\n|\r|\n){2}((\r\n|\r|\n)+)?/g, '$2</p><p>') + '</p>';
					description = description.replace(/(\r\n|\r|\n)/g, '<br>');
					description = description.replace('</p><p></p>', '</p>');
				}
				descriptionBox += description;
			}

			var hasLink = false;
			if(link.trim() !== '')
			{
				hasLink = true;
				descriptionBox += link;
			}

			var $descriptionBox = null;
			if(descriptionBox.trim() !== '')
			{
				$descriptionBox = $(descriptionBox);
				$('<div>').addClass('side-box-content').html(descriptionBox).appendTo($sideBox);
			}

			if($h1.length === 1)
			{
				$content.insertAfter($h1);
			}
			else
			{
				$content.appendTo($main);
			}

			if(hasLink)
			{
				var color = ($content.find('p').first() || $content.find('.side-box-content').first()).css('color');
				$content.find('a').css('color', color);
			}

			 return false;
		}
	});
	(function(){
		function killElem(id){
			var elem = document.getElementById(id);
			if(elem !== null){elem.parentNode.removeChild(elem);}
		}
		killElem('COVID_TEMP-messages');
		killElem('COVID_TEMP-script');
	})();
</script>

    <script>
        // OCNOW-11988 (Cursor): Proactively focus skip link when returning from browser chrome.
        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);
                if (!reentryFromChrome) {
                    return;
                }
                if (isSkipLinkElement(e.target)) {
                    clearGuard();
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);
        })();
    </script>

							                  <!--normalTemplateStart--><h1 class='oc-page-title '>Council Meetings</h1>


<p>Snowy Valleys Council is made up of <a href="https://www.snowyvalleys.nsw.gov.au/Council/About-SVC/Your-Councillors" target="_blank">nine publicly elected Councillors</a>.  </p>
<p>Council meets at least once a month. Members of the public are welcome to attend Council meetings as observers.  Meetings are recorded and also streamed live on our youtube channel <a href="https://www.youtube.com/c/snowyvalleyscouncil" target="_blank">www.youtube.com/c/snowyvalleyscouncil</a></p>
<p><strong>Public Forum</strong></p>
<p>Individuals wishing to address Council can do so at the Public Forum held immediately prior to the meeting. An application must be made in writing 48 hours before the meeting. Refer to the Public Forum Guidelines and application form for more details.</p>
<ul>
<li><a title="Public-Forum-Guidelines-SVC-EXE-Gdl-048-01.pdf" href="/files/assets/public/v/1/meeting-minutes-amp-agendas/council-meetings/council-meeting-forms-and-guidelines/public-forum-guidelines-svc-exe-gdl-048-01.pdf" target="_self" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>SVC-Public-Forum-Guidelines<span class="file-info">(PDF, 240KB)</span></a></li>
<li><a title="Public-Forum-Application-Form-SVC-EXE-F-276-01.pdf" href="/files/assets/public/v/1/meeting-minutes-amp-agendas/council-meetings/council-meeting-forms-and-guidelines/public-forum-application-form-svc-exe-f-276-01.pdf" target="_self" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>SVC-Public-Forum-Application-Form<span class="file-info">(PDF, 223KB)</span></a></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Code of Meeting Practice</strong></p>
<p>All Council Meetings are governed by a code of meeting practices. The SVC Code of Meeting Practice provides details of the procedures and standards for the conduct of Council business at meetings.  <a title="Code-of-Meeting-Practice-2025-SVC-EXE-M-023-06" href="/files/assets/public/v/8/meeting-minutes-amp-agendas/council-meetings/council-meeting-forms-and-guidelines/code-of-meeting-practice-2026-svc-exe-m-023-08.pdf" target="_blank" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Snowy Valleys Council Code of Meeting Practice<span class="file-info">(PDF, 448KB)</span></a></p>
<p>Agendas for monthly ordinary Council meetings, along with any extraordinary Council meetings, are available to the public prior to each meeting.</p>

<li><a href="https://www.snowyvalleys.nsw.gov.au/Council/Council-Meetings/Council-Ordinary-Meeting-Dates">2026 Schedule of Ordinary Meeting Dates</a></li>
</ul>

<script id="COVID_TEMP-script">
	$(document.getElementById('COVID_TEMP-messages').innerHTML).find('.item').each(function(){
		var $message = $(this);
		var isMatch = false;
		$message.find('.conditions a').each(function(){
			var $a = $(this);
			var mode = $a.text().split(' ')[0].toLowerCase();
			var value = $a.attr('href').replace(/^https?:\/\//g, '');

			switch(mode)
			{
				case 'startswith':
					if(document.location.pathname.toLowerCase().startsWith(value.toLowerCase()))
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;

				case 'contains':
					if(document.location.pathname.toLowerCase().indexOf(value.toLowerCase()) !== -1)
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;

				case 'regex':
					var re = new RegExp(value);
					if(new RegExp(value).test(document.location.pathname))
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;

				default:
					if(document.location.pathname.toLowerCase() === value.toLowerCase())
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;
			}
		});
		if(isMatch)
		{
			var $main = $('#main-content');
			if($main.length === 0) return false;
			var $h1 = $main.find('h1').first();

			var title = $message.find('.title').text().trim();
			var type = $message.find('.type').text().trim();
			var description = $message.find('.description').html();
			var link = $message.find('.link').html();

			var $content = $('<section>').addClass('obj-venue');//class is a hack to inherit styling
			var $sideBox = $('<div>').addClass('side-box message-box message-type-'+type).appendTo($content);

			if(title !== '')
			{
				$('<h2>').addClass('side-box-title').text(title).appendTo($sideBox);
			}

			var descriptionBox = ''

			if(description.trim() !== '')
			{
				//If the description contains no html tags, wrap the text in p tags
				var noBrDesc = description.split('<br>').join('\r\n');
				if (!/<[^>]+>/.test(noBrDesc)) {
					description = '<p>' + noBrDesc.replace(/(\r\n|\r|\n){2}((\r\n|\r|\n)+)?/g, '$2</p><p>') + '</p>';
					description = description.replace(/(\r\n|\r|\n)/g, '<br>');
					description = description.replace('</p><p></p>', '</p>');
				}
				descriptionBox += description;
			}

			var hasLink = false;
			if(link.trim() !== '')
			{
				hasLink = true;
				descriptionBox += link;
			}

			var $descriptionBox = null;
			if(descriptionBox.trim() !== '')
			{
				$descriptionBox = $(descriptionBox);
				$('<div>').addClass('side-box-content').html(descriptionBox).appendTo($sideBox);
			}

			if($h1.length === 1)
			{
				$content.insertAfter($h1);
			}
			else
			{
				$content.appendTo($main);
			}

			if(hasLink)
			{
				var color = ($content.find('p').first() || $content.find('.side-box-content').first()).css('color');
				$content.find('a').css('color', color);
			}

			 return false;
		}
	});
	(function(){
		function killElem(id){
			var elem = document.getElementById(id);
			if(elem !== null){elem.parentNode.removeChild(elem);}
		}
		killElem('COVID_TEMP-messages');
		killElem('COVID_TEMP-script');
	})();
</script>

    <script>
        // OCNOW-11988 (Cursor): Proactively focus skip link when returning from browser chrome.
        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);
                if (!reentryFromChrome) {
                    return;
                }
                if (isSkipLinkElement(e.target)) {
                    clearGuard();
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);
        })();
    </script>

							                  <!--normalTemplateStart--><h1 class='oc-page-title '>Council Meetings</h1>


<p>Snowy Valleys Council is made up of <a href="https://www.snowyvalleys.nsw.gov.au/Council/About-SVC/Your-Councillors" target="_blank">nine publicly elected Councillors</a>.  </p>
<p>Council meets at least once a month. Members of the public are welcome to attend Council meetings as observers.  Meetings are recorded and also streamed live on our youtube channel <a href="https://www.youtube.com/c/snowyvalleyscouncil" target="_blank">www.youtube.com/c/snowyvalleyscouncil</a></p>
<p><strong>Public Forum</strong></p>
<p>Individuals wishing to address Council can do so at the Public Forum held immediately prior to the meeting. An application must be made in writing 48 hours before the meeting. Refer to the Public Forum Guidelines and application form for more details.</p>

<script id="COVID_TEMP-script">
	$(document.getElementById('COVID_TEMP-messages').innerHTML).find('.item').each(function(){
		var $message = $(this);
		var isMatch = false;
		$message.find('.conditions a').each(function(){
			var $a = $(this);
			var mode = $a.text().split(' ')[0].toLowerCase();
			var value = $a.attr('href').replace(/^https?:\/\//g, '');

			switch(mode)
			{
				case 'startswith':
					if(document.location.pathname.toLowerCase().startsWith(value.toLowerCase()))
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;

				case 'contains':
					if(document.location.pathname.toLowerCase().indexOf(value.toLowerCase()) !== -1)
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;

				case 'regex':
					var re = new RegExp(value);
					if(new RegExp(value).test(document.location.pathname))
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;

				default:
					if(document.location.pathname.toLowerCase() === value.toLowerCase())
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;
			}
		});
		if(isMatch)
		{
			var $main = $('#main-content');
			if($main.length === 0) return false;
			var $h1 = $main.find('h1').first();

			var title = $message.find('.title').text().trim();
			var type = $message.find('.type').text().trim();
			var description = $message.find('.description').html();
			var link = $message.find('.link').html();

			var $content = $('<section>').addClass('obj-venue');//class is a hack to inherit styling
			var $sideBox = $('<div>').addClass('side-box message-box message-type-'+type).appendTo($content);

			if(title !== '')
			{
				$('<h2>').addClass('side-box-title').text(title).appendTo($sideBox);
			}

			var descriptionBox = ''

			if(description.trim() !== '')
			{
				//If the description contains no html tags, wrap the text in p tags
				var noBrDesc = description.split('<br>').join('\r\n');
				if (!/<[^>]+>/.test(noBrDesc)) {
					description = '<p>' + noBrDesc.replace(/(\r\n|\r|\n){2}((\r\n|\r|\n)+)?/g, '$2</p><p>') + '</p>';
					description = description.replace(/(\r\n|\r|\n)/g, '<br>');
					description = description.replace('</p><p></p>', '</p>');
				}
				descriptionBox += description;
			}

			var hasLink = false;
			if(link.trim() !== '')
			{
				hasLink = true;
				descriptionBox += link;
			}

			var $descriptionBox = null;
			if(descriptionBox.trim() !== '')
			{
				$descriptionBox = $(descriptionBox);
				$('<div>').addClass('side-box-content').html(descriptionBox).appendTo($sideBox);
			}

			if($h1.length === 1)
			{
				$content.insertAfter($h1);
			}
			else
			{
				$content.appendTo($main);
			}

			if(hasLink)
			{
				var color = ($content.find('p').first() || $content.find('.side-box-content').first()).css('color');
				$content.find('a').css('color', color);
			}

			 return false;
		}
	});
	(function(){
		function killElem(id){
			var elem = document.getElementById(id);
			if(elem !== null){elem.parentNode.removeChild(elem);}
		}
		killElem('COVID_TEMP-messages');
		killElem('COVID_TEMP-script');
	})();
</script>

							                  <!--normalTemplateStart--><h1 class='oc-page-title '>Council Meetings</h1>


<p>Snowy Valleys Council is made up of <a href="https://www.snowyvalleys.nsw.gov.au/Council/About-SVC/Your-Councillors" target="_blank">nine publicly elected Councillors</a>.  </p>
<p>Council meets at least once a month. Members of the public are welcome to attend Council meetings as observers.  Meetings are recorded and also streamed live on our youtube channel <a href="https://www.youtube.com/c/snowyvalleyscouncil" target="_blank">www.youtube.com/c/snowyvalleyscouncil</a></p>
<p><strong>Public Forum</strong></p>
<p>Individuals wishing to address Council can do so at the Public Forum held immediately prior to the meeting. An application must be made in writing 48 hours before the meeting. Refer to the Public Forum Guidelines and application form for more details.</p>
<ul>
<li><a title="Public-Forum-Guidelines-SVC-EXE-Gdl-048-01.pdf" href="/files/assets/public/v/1/meeting-minutes-amp-agendas/council-meetings/council-meeting-forms-and-guidelines/public-forum-guidelines-svc-exe-gdl-048-01.pdf" target="_self" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>SVC-Public-Forum-Guidelines<span class="file-info">(PDF, 240KB)</span></a></li>
<li><a title="Public-Forum-Application-Form-SVC-EXE-F-276-01.pdf" href="/files/assets/public/v/1/meeting-minutes-amp-agendas/council-meetings/council-meeting-forms-and-guidelines/public-forum-application-form-svc-exe-f-276-01.pdf" target="_self" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>SVC-Public-Forum-Application-Form<span class="file-info">(PDF, 223KB)</span></a></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Code of Meeting Practice</strong></p>
<p>All Council Meetings are governed by a code of meeting practices. The SVC Code of Meeting Practice provides details of the procedures and standards for the conduct of Council business at meetings.  <a title="Code-of-Meeting-Practice-2025-SVC-EXE-M-023-06" href="/files/assets/public/v/8/meeting-minutes-amp-agendas/council-meetings/council-meeting-forms-and-guidelines/code-of-meeting-practice-2026-svc-exe-m-023-08.pdf" target="_blank" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Snowy Valleys Council Code of Meeting Practice<span class="file-info">(PDF, 448KB)</span></a></p>
<p>Agendas for monthly ordinary Council meetings, along with any extraordinary Council meetings, are available to the public prior to each meeting.</p>

    <div data-nosnippet>

<div class="item">
	<div class="title">Libraries</div>
	<div class="description">Due to the current COVID lockdown orders our Libraries are currently closed.</div>

	<div class="title">Liquid Trade Waste</div>
	<div class="description">Please note: any changes in business activities that are likely to increase the discharged volume and/or to discharge wastewater from modified/new processes to council’s sewerage system during to the current pandemic situation, still require Council approval. <br/>Please contact Council on 1300 ASK SVC  (1300 275 782) or email info@svc.nsw.gov.au should you require any further information.</div>
	<div class="link"></div>
	<div class="type">Temporary Closure</div>

</div>

<script id="COVID_TEMP-script">
	$(document.getElementById('COVID_TEMP-messages').innerHTML).find('.item').each(function(){
		var $message = $(this);
		var isMatch = false;
		$message.find('.conditions a').each(function(){
			var $a = $(this);
			var mode = $a.text().split(' ')[0].toLowerCase();
			var value = $a.attr('href').replace(/^https?:\/\//g, '');

			switch(mode)
			{
				case 'startswith':
					if(document.location.pathname.toLowerCase().startsWith(value.toLowerCase()))
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;

				case 'contains':
					if(document.location.pathname.toLowerCase().indexOf(value.toLowerCase()) !== -1)
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;

				case 'regex':
					var re = new RegExp(value);
					if(new RegExp(value).test(document.location.pathname))
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;

				default:
					if(document.location.pathname.toLowerCase() === value.toLowerCase())
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;
			}
		});
		if(isMatch)
		{
			var $main = $('#main-content');
			if($main.length === 0) return false;
			var $h1 = $main.find('h1').first();

			var title = $message.find('.title').text().trim();
			var type = $message.find('.type').text().trim();
			var description = $message.find('.description').html();
			var link = $message.find('.link').html();

			var $content = $('<section>').addClass('obj-venue');//class is a hack to inherit styling
			var $sideBox = $('<div>').addClass('side-box message-box message-type-'+type).appendTo($content);

			if(title !== '')
			{
				$('<h2>').addClass('side-box-title').text(title).appendTo($sideBox);
			}

			var descriptionBox = ''

			if(description.trim() !== '')
			{
				//If the description contains no html tags, wrap the text in p tags
				var noBrDesc = description.split('<br>').join('\r\n');
				if (!/<[^>]+>/.test(noBrDesc)) {
					description = '<p>' + noBrDesc.replace(/(\r\n|\r|\n){2}((\r\n|\r|\n)+)?/g, '$2</p><p>') + '</p>';
					description = description.replace(/(\r\n|\r|\n)/g, '<br>');
					description = description.replace('</p><p></p>', '</p>');
				}
				descriptionBox += description;
			}

			var hasLink = false;
			if(link.trim() !== '')
			{
				hasLink = true;
				descriptionBox += link;
			}

			var $descriptionBox = null;
			if(descriptionBox.trim() !== '')
			{
				$descriptionBox = $(descriptionBox);
				$('<div>').addClass('side-box-content').html(descriptionBox).appendTo($sideBox);
			}

			if($h1.length === 1)
			{
				$content.insertAfter($h1);
			}
			else
			{
				$content.appendTo($main);
			}

			if(hasLink)
			{
				var color = ($content.find('p').first() || $content.find('.side-box-content').first()).css('color');
				$content.find('a').css('color', color);
			}

			 return false;
		}
	});
	(function(){
		function killElem(id){
			var elem = document.getElementById(id);
			if(elem !== null){elem.parentNode.removeChild(elem);}
		}
		killElem('COVID_TEMP-messages');
		killElem('COVID_TEMP-script');
	})();
</script>

    <script>
        // OCNOW-11988 (Cursor): Proactively focus skip link when returning from browser chrome.
        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);
                if (!reentryFromChrome) {
                    return;
                }
                if (isSkipLinkElement(e.target)) {
                    clearGuard();
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);
        })();
    </script>

							                  <!--normalTemplateStart--><h1 class='oc-page-title '>Council Meetings</h1>


<p>Snowy Valleys Council is made up of <a href="https://www.snowyvalleys.nsw.gov.au/Council/About-SVC/Your-Councillors" target="_blank">nine publicly elected Councillors</a>.  </p>
<p>Council meets at least once a month. Members of the public are welcome to attend Council meetings as observers.  Meetings are recorded and also streamed live on our youtube channel <a href="https://www.youtube.com/c/snowyvalleyscouncil" target="_blank">www.youtube.com/c/snowyvalleyscouncil</a></p>
<p><strong>Public Forum</strong></p>
<p>Individuals wishing to address Council can do so at the Public Forum held immediately prior to the meeting. An application must be made in writing 48 hours before the meeting. Refer to the Public Forum Guidelines and application form for more details.</p>
<ul>
<li><a title="Public-Forum-Guidelines-SVC-EXE-Gdl-048-01.pdf" href="/files/assets/public/v/1/meeting-minutes-amp-agendas/council-meetings/council-meeting-forms-and-guidelines/public-forum-guidelines-svc-exe-gdl-048-01.pdf" target="_self" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>SVC-Public-Forum-Guidelines<span class="file-info">(PDF, 240KB)</span></a></li>
<li><a title="Public-Forum-Application-Form-SVC-EXE-F-276-01.pdf" href="/files/assets/public/v/1/meeting-minutes-amp-agendas/council-meetings/council-meeting-forms-and-guidelines/public-forum-application-form-svc-exe-f-276-01.pdf" target="_self" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>SVC-Public-Forum-Application-Form<span class="file-info">(PDF, 223KB)</span></a></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Code of Meeting Practice</strong></p>
<p>All Council Meetings are governed by a code of meeting practices. The SVC Code of Meeting Practice provides details of the procedures and standards for the conduct of Council business at meetings.  <a title="Code-of-Meeting-Practice-2025-SVC-EXE-M-023-06" href="/files/assets/public/v/8/meeting-minutes-amp-agendas/council-meetings/council-meeting-forms-and-guidelines/code-of-meeting-practice-2026-svc-exe-m-023-08.pdf" target="_blank" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Snowy Valleys Council Code of Meeting Practice<span class="file-info">(PDF, 448KB)</span></a></p>
<p>Agendas for monthly ordinary Council meetings, along with any extraordinary Council meetings, are available to the public prior to each meeting.</p>

<li><a href="https://www.snowyvalleys.nsw.gov.au/Council/Council-Meetings/Council-Ordinary-Meeting-Dates">2026 Schedule of Ordinary Meeting Dates</a></li>

<script id="COVID_TEMP-script">
	$(document.getElementById('COVID_TEMP-messages').innerHTML).find('.item').each(function(){
		var $message = $(this);
		var isMatch = false;
		$message.find('.conditions a').each(function(){
			var $a = $(this);
			var mode = $a.text().split(' ')[0].toLowerCase();
			var value = $a.attr('href').replace(/^https?:\/\//g, '');

			switch(mode)
			{
				case 'startswith':
					if(document.location.pathname.toLowerCase().startsWith(value.toLowerCase()))
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;

				case 'contains':
					if(document.location.pathname.toLowerCase().indexOf(value.toLowerCase()) !== -1)
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;

				case 'regex':
					var re = new RegExp(value);
					if(new RegExp(value).test(document.location.pathname))
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;

				default:
					if(document.location.pathname.toLowerCase() === value.toLowerCase())
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;
			}
		});
		if(isMatch)
		{
			var $main = $('#main-content');
			if($main.length === 0) return false;
			var $h1 = $main.find('h1').first();

			var title = $message.find('.title').text().trim();
			var type = $message.find('.type').text().trim();
			var description = $message.find('.description').html();
			var link = $message.find('.link').html();

			var $content = $('<section>').addClass('obj-venue');//class is a hack to inherit styling
			var $sideBox = $('<div>').addClass('side-box message-box message-type-'+type).appendTo($content);

			if(title !== '')
			{
				$('<h2>').addClass('side-box-title').text(title).appendTo($sideBox);
			}

			var descriptionBox = ''

			if(description.trim() !== '')
			{
				//If the description contains no html tags, wrap the text in p tags
				var noBrDesc = description.split('<br>').join('\r\n');
				if (!/<[^>]+>/.test(noBrDesc)) {
					description = '<p>' + noBrDesc.replace(/(\r\n|\r|\n){2}((\r\n|\r|\n)+)?/g, '$2</p><p>') + '</p>';
					description = description.replace(/(\r\n|\r|\n)/g, '<br>');
					description = description.replace('</p><p></p>', '</p>');
				}
				descriptionBox += description;
			}

			var hasLink = false;
			if(link.trim() !== '')
			{
				hasLink = true;
				descriptionBox += link;
			}

			var $descriptionBox = null;
			if(descriptionBox.trim() !== '')
			{
				$descriptionBox = $(descriptionBox);
				$('<div>').addClass('side-box-content').html(descriptionBox).appendTo($sideBox);
			}

			if($h1.length === 1)
			{
				$content.insertAfter($h1);
			}
			else
			{
				$content.appendTo($main);
			}

			if(hasLink)
			{
				var color = ($content.find('p').first() || $content.find('.side-box-content').first()).css('color');
				$content.find('a').css('color', color);
			}

			 return false;
		}
	});

			var elem = document.getElementById(id);
			if(elem !== null){elem.parentNode.removeChild(elem);}
		}
		killElem('COVID_TEMP-messages');
		killElem('COVID_TEMP-script');
	})();
</script>

    <script>
        // OCNOW-11988 (Cursor): Proactively focus skip link when returning from browser chrome.
        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);
                if (!reentryFromChrome) {
                    return;
                }
                if (isSkipLinkElement(e.target)) {
                    clearGuard();
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);
        })();
    </script>

							                  <!--normalTemplateStart--><h1 class='oc-page-title '>Council Meetings</h1>


<p>Snowy Valleys Council is made up of <a href="https://www.snowyvalleys.nsw.gov.au/Council/About-SVC/Your-Councillors" target="_blank">nine publicly elected Councillors</a>.  </p>
<p>Council meets at least once a month. Members of the public are welcome to attend Council meetings as observers.  Meetings are recorded and also streamed live on our youtube channel <a href="https://www.youtube.com/c/snowyvalleyscouncil" target="_blank">www.youtube.com/c/snowyvalleyscouncil</a></p>
<p><strong>Public Forum</strong></p>
<p>Individuals wishing to address Council can do so at the Public Forum held immediately prior to the meeting. An application must be made in writing 48 hours before the meeting. Refer to the Public Forum Guidelines and application form for more details.</p>
<ul>
<li><a title="Public-Forum-Guidelines-SVC-EXE-Gdl-048-01.pdf" href="/files/assets/public/v/1/meeting-minutes-amp-agendas/council-meetings/council-meeting-forms-and-guidelines/public-forum-guidelines-svc-exe-gdl-048-01.pdf" target="_self" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>SVC-Public-Forum-Guidelines<span class="file-info">(PDF, 240KB)</span></a></li>
<li><a title="Public-Forum-Application-Form-SVC-EXE-F-276-01.pdf" href="/files/assets/public/v/1/meeting-minutes-amp-agendas/council-meetings/council-meeting-forms-and-guidelines/public-forum-application-form-svc-exe-f-276-01.pdf" target="_self" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>SVC-Public-Forum-Application-Form<span class="file-info">(PDF, 223KB)</span></a></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Code of Meeting Practice</strong></p>
<p>All Council Meetings are governed by a code of meeting practices. The SVC Code of Meeting Practice provides details of the procedures and standards for the conduct of Council business at meetings.  <a title="Code-of-Meeting-Practice-2025-SVC-EXE-M-023-06" href="/files/assets/public/v/8/meeting-minutes-amp-agendas/council-meetings/council-meeting-forms-and-guidelines/code-of-meeting-practice-2026-svc-exe-m-023-08.pdf" target="_blank" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Snowy Valleys Council Code of Meeting Practice<span class="file-info">(PDF, 448KB)</span></a></p>
<p>Agendas for monthly ordinary Council meetings, along with any extraordinary Council meetings, are available to the public prior to each meeting.</p>

						return false;//stop jquery each

					{

						return false;//stop jquery each
					}

                    return;

                }

            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);
                if (!reentryFromChrome) {
                    return;
                }
                if (isSkipLinkElement(e.target)) {
                    clearGuard();
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);
        })();

							                  <!--normalTemplateStart--><h1 class='oc-page-title '>Council Meetings</h1>


<p>Snowy Valleys Council is made up of <a href="https://www.snowyvalleys.nsw.gov.au/Council/About-SVC/Your-Councillors" target="_blank">nine publicly elected Councillors</a>.  </p>
<p>Council meets at least once a month. Members of the public are welcome to attend Council meetings as observers.  Meetings are recorded and also streamed live on our youtube channel <a href="https://www.youtube.com/c/snowyvalleyscouncil" target="_blank">www.youtube.com/c/snowyvalleyscouncil</a></p>
<p><strong>Public Forum</strong></p>
<p>Individuals wishing to address Council can do so at the Public Forum held immediately prior to the meeting. An application must be made in writing 48 hours before the meeting. Refer to the Public Forum Guidelines and application form for more details.</p>
<ul>
<li><a title="Public-Forum-Guidelines-SVC-EXE-Gdl-048-01.pdf" href="/files/assets/public/v/1/meeting-minutes-amp-agendas/council-meetings/council-meeting-forms-and-guidelines/public-forum-guidelines-svc-exe-gdl-048-01.pdf" target="_self" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>SVC-Public-Forum-Guidelines<span class="file-info">(PDF, 240KB)</span></a></li>
<li><a title="Public-Forum-Application-Form-SVC-EXE-F-276-01.pdf" href="/files/assets/public/v/1/meeting-minutes-amp-agendas/council-meetings/council-meeting-forms-and-guidelines/public-forum-application-form-svc-exe-f-276-01.pdf" target="_self" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>SVC-Public-Forum-Application-Form<span class="file-info">(PDF, 223KB)</span></a></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Code of Meeting Practice</strong></p>
<p>All Council Meetings are governed by a code of meeting practices. The SVC Code of Meeting Practice provides details of the procedures and standards for the conduct of Council business at meetings.  <a title="Code-of-Meeting-Practice-2025-SVC-EXE-M-023-06" href="/files/assets/public/v/8/meeting-minutes-amp-agendas/council-meetings/council-meeting-forms-and-guidelines/code-of-meeting-practice-2026-svc-exe-m-023-08.pdf" target="_blank" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Snowy Valleys Council Code of Meeting Practice<span class="file-info">(PDF, 448KB)</span></a></p>
<p>Agendas for monthly ordinary Council meetings, along with any extraordinary Council meetings, are available to the public prior to each meeting.</p>

<script id="COVID_TEMP-script">
	$(document.getElementById('COVID_TEMP-messages').innerHTML).find('.item').each(function(){
		var $message = $(this);
		var isMatch = false;
		$message.find('.conditions a').each(function(){
			var $a = $(this);
			var mode = $a.text().split(' ')[0].toLowerCase();
			var value = $a.attr('href').replace(/^https?:\/\//g, '');

			switch(mode)
			{
				case 'startswith':
					if(document.location.pathname.toLowerCase().startsWith(value.toLowerCase()))
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;

				case 'contains':
					if(document.location.pathname.toLowerCase().indexOf(value.toLowerCase()) !== -1)
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;

				case 'regex':
					var re = new RegExp(value);
					if(new RegExp(value).test(document.location.pathname))
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;

				default:
					if(document.location.pathname.toLowerCase() === value.toLowerCase())
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;
			}
		});
		if(isMatch)
		{
			var $main = $('#main-content');
			if($main.length === 0) return false;
			var $h1 = $main.find('h1').first();

			var title = $message.find('.title').text().trim();
			var type = $message.find('.type').text().trim();
			var description = $message.find('.description').html();
			var link = $message.find('.link').html();

			var $content = $('<section>').addClass('obj-venue');//class is a hack to inherit styling
			var $sideBox = $('<div>').addClass('side-box message-box message-type-'+type).appendTo($content);

			if(title !== '')
			{
				$('<h2>').addClass('side-box-title').text(title).appendTo($sideBox);
			}

			var descriptionBox = ''

			if(description.trim() !== '')
			{
				//If the description contains no html tags, wrap the text in p tags
				var noBrDesc = description.split('<br>').join('\r\n');
				if (!/<[^>]+>/.test(noBrDesc)) {
					description = '<p>' + noBrDesc.replace(/(\r\n|\r|\n){2}((\r\n|\r|\n)+)?/g, '$2</p><p>') + '</p>';
					description = description.replace(/(\r\n|\r|\n)/g, '<br>');
					description = description.replace('</p><p></p>', '</p>');
				}
				descriptionBox += description;
			}

			var hasLink = false;
			if(link.trim() !== '')
			{
				hasLink = true;
				descriptionBox += link;
			}

			var $descriptionBox = null;
			if(descriptionBox.trim() !== '')
			{
				$descriptionBox = $(descriptionBox);
				$('<div>').addClass('side-box-content').html(descriptionBox).appendTo($sideBox);
			}

			if($h1.length === 1)
			{
				$content.insertAfter($h1);
			}
			else
			{
				$content.appendTo($main);
			}

			if(hasLink)
			{
				var color = ($content.find('p').first() || $content.find('.side-box-content').first()).css('color');
				$content.find('a').css('color', color);
			}

			 return false;
		}
	});
	(function(){
		function killElem(id){
			var elem = document.getElementById(id);
			if(elem !== null){elem.parentNode.removeChild(elem);}
		}
		killElem('COVID_TEMP-messages');
		killElem('COVID_TEMP-script');
	})();
</script>

    <script>
        // OCNOW-11988 (Cursor): Proactively focus skip link when returning from browser chrome.
        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);
                if (!reentryFromChrome) {
                    return;
                }
                if (isSkipLinkElement(e.target)) {
                    clearGuard();
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);
        })();

							                  <!--normalTemplateStart--><h1 class='oc-page-title '>Council Meetings</h1>


<p>Snowy Valleys Council is made up of <a href="https://www.snowyvalleys.nsw.gov.au/Council/About-SVC/Your-Councillors" target="_blank">nine publicly elected Councillors</a>.  </p>
<p>Council meets at least once a month. Members of the public are welcome to attend Council meetings as observers.  Meetings are recorded and also streamed live on our youtube channel <a href="https://www.youtube.com/c/snowyvalleyscouncil" target="_blank">www.youtube.com/c/snowyvalleyscouncil</a></p>
<p><strong>Public Forum</strong></p>
<p>Individuals wishing to address Council can do so at the Public Forum held immediately prior to the meeting. An application must be made in writing 48 hours before the meeting. Refer to the Public Forum Guidelines and application form for more details.</p>
<ul>
<li><a title="Public-Forum-Guidelines-SVC-EXE-Gdl-048-01.pdf" href="/files/assets/public/v/1/meeting-minutes-amp-agendas/council-meetings/council-meeting-forms-and-guidelines/public-forum-guidelines-svc-exe-gdl-048-01.pdf" target="_self" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>SVC-Public-Forum-Guidelines<span class="file-info">(PDF, 240KB)</span></a></li>
<li><a title="Public-Forum-Application-Form-SVC-EXE-F-276-01.pdf" href="/files/assets/public/v/1/meeting-minutes-amp-agendas/council-meetings/council-meeting-forms-and-guidelines/public-forum-application-form-svc-exe-f-276-01.pdf" target="_self" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>SVC-Public-Forum-Application-Form<span class="file-info">(PDF, 223KB)</span></a></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Code of Meeting Practice</strong></p>
<p>All Council Meetings are governed by a code of meeting practices. The SVC Code of Meeting Practice provides details of the procedures and standards for the conduct of Council business at meetings.  <a title="Code-of-Meeting-Practice-2025-SVC-EXE-M-023-06" href="/files/assets/public/v/8/meeting-minutes-amp-agendas/council-meetings/council-meeting-forms-and-guidelines/code-of-meeting-practice-2026-svc-exe-m-023-08.pdf" target="_blank" class="document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Snowy Valleys Council Code of Meeting Practice<span class="file-info">(PDF, 448KB)</span></a></p>
<p>Agendas for monthly ordinary Council meetings, along with any extraordinary Council meetings, are available to the public prior to each meeting.</p>

    <div data-nosnippet>

<div class="item">

<script id="COVID_TEMP-script">
	$(document.getElementById('COVID_TEMP-messages').innerHTML).find('.item').each(function(){
		var $message = $(this);
		var isMatch = false;
		$message.find('.conditions a').each(function(){
			var $a = $(this);
			var mode = $a.text().split(' ')[0].toLowerCase();
			var value = $a.attr('href').replace(/^https?:\/\//g, '');

			switch(mode)
			{
				case 'startswith':
					if(document.location.pathname.toLowerCase().startsWith(value.toLowerCase()))
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;

				case 'contains':
					if(document.location.pathname.toLowerCase().indexOf(value.toLowerCase()) !== -1)
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;

				case 'regex':
					var re = new RegExp(value);
					if(new RegExp(value).test(document.location.pathname))
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;

				default:
					if(document.location.pathname.toLowerCase() === value.toLowerCase())
					{
						isMatch = true;
						return false;//stop jquery each
					}
					break;
			}
		});
		if(isMatch)
		{
			var $main = $('#main-content');
			if($main.length === 0) return false;
			var $h1 = $main.find('h1').first();

			var title = $message.find('.title').text().trim();
			var type = $message.find('.type').text().trim();
			var description = $message.find('.description').html();
			var link = $message.find('.link').html();

			var $content = $('<section>').addClass('obj-venue');//class is a hack to inherit styling
			var $sideBox = $('<div>').addClass('side-box message-box message-type-'+type).appendTo($content);

			if(title !== '')
			{
				$('<h2>').addClass('side-box-title').text(title).appendTo($sideBox);
			}

			var descriptionBox = ''

			if(description.trim() !== '')
			{
				//If the description contains no html tags, wrap the text in p tags
				var noBrDesc = description.split('<br>').join('\r\n');
				if (!/<[^>]+>/.test(noBrDesc)) {
					description = '<p>' + noBrDesc.replace(/(\r\n|\r|\n){2}((\r\n|\r|\n)+)?/g, '$2</p><p>') + '</p>';
					description = description.replace(/(\r\n|\r|\n)/g, '<br>');
					description = description.replace('</p><p></p>', '</p>');
				}
				descriptionBox += description;
			}

			var hasLink = false;
			if(link.trim() !== '')
			{
				hasLink = true;
				descriptionBox += link;
			}

			var $descriptionBox = null;
			if(descriptionBox.trim() !== '')
			{
				$descriptionBox = $(descriptionBox);
				$('<div>').addClass('side-box-content').html(descriptionBox).appendTo($sideBox);
			}

			if($h1.length === 1)
			{
				$content.insertAfter($h1);
			}
			else
			{
				$content.appendTo($main);
			}

			if(hasLink)
			{
				var color = ($content.find('p').first() || $content.find('.side-box-content').first()).css('color');
				$content.find('a').css('color', color);
			}

			 return false;
		}
	});
	(function(){
		function killElem(id){
			var elem = document.getElementById(id);
			if(elem !== null){elem.parentNode.removeChild(elem);}
		}
		killElem('COVID_TEMP-messages');
		killElem('COVID_TEMP-script');
	})();
</script>
